scope.source: Explicit IDs in output/product-v2-langfuse.json; final IDs from output/product-v2-quality-audit.json. Unrelated/synthetic telemetry traces excluded.
scope.final_four_are_not_four_new_v23_generati: Original generations span v2.1, v2.2 and v2.3; final artifacts were deterministically recompiled under v2.3 with zero added model calls.

measurement_method.overall_tokens: Exact provider receipt counts, already reconciled with Langfuse.
measurement_method.component_sizes: Unicode character counts of raw prompts or ensure_ascii=False compact JSON. Character shares are NOT token shares; no chars-to-token conversion was used.
measurement_method.schema_serialization: Canonical compact JSON object size for comparisons, not a claim about the provider internal schema tokenization.
measurement_method.reasoning_accounting: reasoning_tokens is a subset of output_tokens, cached_tokens is a subset of input_tokens; exclusive components subtract them once.
measurement_method.cost_decomposition: The observed 10 receipts all exactly fit USD per 1M tokens: uncached input 2.5, cached input 0.25, inclusive output 15. These are an empirical decomposition of these receipts, not a live pricing assertion.
measurement_method.unknown_cost_policy: No unknown cost treated as zero; all ten audited receipts report usage.cost.

development_fallbacks.note: Separate development invocations after policy/code changes, not automatic multi-call retries in a single product run.

lossless_transport_proposal_final_four.warning: Character reduction is not a measured token or dollar saving. No model call or production modification performed.

findings.finding: Stop asking the model to generate scalar prose and operational artifacts that deterministic code overwrites.
findings.safe_change_boundary: Create a smaller model-output DTO and assemble ProductPlan afterward. Keep candidate comparison, content work, asset roles/mandatory criteria, product receipts and usable content unchanged. Do not merely make required legacy fields empty without updating validators.

findings.finding: Remove duplicate relationship paths and the prompt-level evidence ID inventory; share identical reference enums in the schema.
findings.safe_change_boundary: Keep the full evidence repository and graph for computation/audit. Removing their redundant textual serialization does not mean removing the graph. Keep strict allowed-reference validation and test $ref support.

findings.finding: Intern repeated metric descriptions and inherit child observation IDs from their parent instead of restating them.
findings.safe_change_boundary: Keep every numerator/denominator and exact original description through a dictionary. Do not replace source metadata or metric meaning with guessed summaries.

findings.finding: Replace stacked legacy DESIGN plus production instructions with one production-only contract.

duplicated_concepts: one selected action and no extra question alternatives
all owned source assessments and role separation
exact verified route and six integration phases

findings.safe_change_boundary: Retain COMMON security/evidence rules and one copy of each business invariant. Legacy observe/needs_data plan-generation branches are unreachable after production gate, but operational observe can still be an intervention candidate and must remain distinct.

findings.finding: Use selected-question detail with explicit cross-question counterevidence, rather than blindly passing or blindly deleting the entire topic.
findings.safe_change_boundary: Always keep all owned asset metadata, selected question answer text/mentions/citations, quality/missingness, topic summary and known product facts. Deterministically select or summarize relevant other-question asset/counterevidence before the call; the hindsight compression numbers are not a deployable selection rule.

findings.finding: Reasoning tokens dominate output cost, but lowering reasoning or the cap is a quality experiment, not a free optimization.
findings.safe_change_boundary: Keep the 16k safety cap until output DTO/prompt compaction is validated. Reducing the cap already truncated two real outputs. Lower effort/model choice needs a separately authorized paired quality/cost comparison, not an assumed saving.

findings.finding: Observed token-cache savings come from repeated development prompts, not an established production hit rate.
findings.safe_change_boundary: Keep exact-result cache and provider prompt-cache accounting separate. Put invariant instructions/schema before request data when designing a compact prompt, but do not budget assuming this repeated-development cache rate.

must_preserve: Three distinct interventions for the same selected question and explicit selected/deferred/rejected reasons, effort, feasibility and reversal conditions.
Candidate-specific evidence links and observed answer text supporting the proposed mechanism; preserve counterevidence rather than truncating by question ID alone.
All target-owned asset metadata and one role assessment per asset; supporting_only versus editable source separation; mandatory reuse criteria.
Verified product facts, unsupported/unknown flags, origin labels and exact receipt/route; preserve the six-phase integration procedure for a confirmed route.
At least one useful task-specific example_content plus content_work steps, owner, prerequisites and acceptance criteria.
Selected-question mention/recommendation baselines, eligible denominators, missingness, source ownership and metric identifiers; keep any consciously selected wider secondary metric scope.
Original traces, full repository/graph and post-generation reference/contract validators remain authoritative even if the LLM transport is smaller.
